title: Typed Form Handlers
description: Build type-safe forms with React Hook Form and TypeScript.

data.text: React Hook Form with TypeScript provides fully typed form validation, submission handling, and error messages.

data.title: Typed Form
Type Safety
data.text: By passing a generic to useForm, TypeScript will autocomplete field names and validate your submission data.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Pass it as a generic to useForm
data.takeaway: Typed forms eliminate an entire class of runtime bugs.
